Name: Trash Bear is Just a Girly Retexture
Author: mygenderisgremlin
Description:
Retexture/recolour of the trash bear :D 3 variations available. Requires Content Patcher.

[b]Changes: 
[/b][list]
[*]All versions include a little flower crown
[*]"Flower Crown Only" main file version is vanilla + flower crown, no other changes
[*]The other two main file versions feature a pinkish/purple-ish recolour with some white accents added to Trash Bear's tail tip, teeth, paws, etc
[*]Only difference between the two recoloured versions is how dark and vibrant the recolour is 
[*]And obviously the recoloured two main file versions also feature the flower crown! 
[/list]
[b]Requirements:
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿ latest version (duh)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher﻿[/url]﻿ latest version (obviously)

I highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10455]Stardrop﻿[/url]﻿ to manage your mods, but it is not required.

[b]Installation:
[/b][list]
[*]Install latest version of SMAPI. 
[*]Install latest version of Content Patcher. 
[*]Install this mod either manually or with a mod manager.
[*]You're done! 
[/list][b]Compatibility:
[/b]This mod should be compatible with all the usual mods we have in our load orders.

Compatible with Stardew 1.6.

Unfortunately, I am not at the stage in my playthrough where I can test the mod myself. So if you have any issues, please let me know. 

[b]Permissions:
[/b][list]
[*]Uploading to other sites - [b]I'd strongly prefer that all of my mods stay on Nexus exclusively, so please refrain from doing this.  [/b]
[*]Adding to collections - [b]go for it :) [/b]
[*]Creating your own versions and uploading on Nexus - [b]go crazy! But please credit me for the original <3[/b]
[/list]
[b]Credits:
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild]Pathoschild[/url]﻿ for SMAPI and Content Patcher

[b]Tools Used: 
[/b]Thank f*** for [url=https://www.pixquare.art/]Pixsquare[/url]﻿ because I am 1) very new to this, and 2) terrible at art, so trying to make this mod on my iPad using Pro Create was driving me bananas.
